# Traefik — custom-context

App on /app context, proxy preserves the same path so the backend sees the original URL unchanged. Nothing has to be rewritten in either direction.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/app/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# App on the /app context, proxy preserves the same path, so the backend sees
# the original URL unchanged. No prefix middleware, and nothing to rewrite on
# the way out: the public path and the context path are the same string.
http:
  routers:
    vaadin:
      # Two clauses, not a bare PathPrefix(`/app`). Traefik's PathPrefix is a
      # raw string prefix, so the bare form also matches /application. Every
      # context-prefix rule in this tree is written this way.
      rule: PathPrefix(`/app/`) || Path(`/app`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      middlewares:
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
